title:
This type describes an interface to a modelable object that can be used to train and process the
{@link ReliabilityRiskMl.ControlValvesReconstructionPipeline}. Any type that implements this interface should
implement the following methods:

`doTrainReconstruction` and `doProcessReconstruction`: these methods should be implemented to specify how to train and
process the {@link ReliabilityRiskMl.ControlValvesReconstructionPipeline#reconstructionPipe}.

`doTrainRiskScore` and `doProcessRiskScore`: these methods should be implemented to specify how to train and
process the {@link ReliabilityRiskMl.ControlValvesReconstructionPipeline#riskScorePipe}.

`doInterpret`: this method should be implemented to specify how to generate feature contributions from the
{@link ReliabilityRiskMl.ControlValvesReconstructionPipeline#interpreter}.
name: ControlValvesModelableMethods
